subject: Social Media
title: Viral Mob Justice
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Viral Mob Justice.

hook.text: Justine Sacco tweeted a bad joke to 170 followers. She landed 11 hours later to worldwide condemnation.

buildup.text: While she flew, the tweet went viral. Strangers tracked her flight. A hashtag trended. Her career ended.

discovery.text: Jon Ronson studied viral shaming. The punishment never fits the crime. One mistake becomes a life sentence.

twist.text: Participants feel righteous. Each person adds one small push. Nobody thinks they're part of a mob.

climax.text: Viral justice has no appeals court. No proportionality. No forgiveness mechanism. Only the pile-on.

punchline.text: The mob doesn't punish. It destroys.

quiz.question: What happened to Justine Sacco after her tweet went viral?
options: Her career was destroyed by worldwide condemnation
